content: गम {%a.%} [गम् भावादौ अप्] (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Going, moving, going to, reaching, attaining, getting <ab>&c.</ab>; खगम, पुरोगम, हृदयंगम, <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-मः@} .²1 Going, moving. .²2 March; आदरेण गमं चक्रुर्विषमेष्वप्यसङ्घसाः <ls>Bk. 7. 56</ls>; अश्वस्यैकाहगमः. .²3 The march of an assailant. .²4 A road. .²5 Inconsiderateness, thoughtlessness. .²6 Superficiality, careless perusal. .²7 (Sexual) intercourse with a woman, cohabitation; गुर्वङ्गनागमः <ls>Ms. 11. 55</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 293</ls>. .²8 A game played with dice and men. .²9 Removal (as of fraction in <ab>math.</ab>)
